title: Submitting the Group Project
transcript:
Hello. Our group project is due this afternoon, but the submission page keeps showing an error. We tried two computers and got the same message.
The technical team is working on it. Your tutor has arranged a temporary email address for submissions, so you do not need to bring a printed copy here.
That's helpful. Our report and the interview notes are in separate files. Should we combine them before sending the email, or leave them as they are?
Leave them separate. Put your group number at the start of both file names, followed by report or notes. That will help the tutor match them correctly.
I can do that now. Does every group member have to send a copy? We were worried that one message might not arrive.
Only one person should send the files. Copy the other members into the email so everyone has a record. You will receive an automatic reply confirming receipt.
What if the reply doesn't arrive before the deadline? I don't want to keep sending duplicates and create confusion.
Wait fifteen minutes, then call this office with the time you sent the message. We can check the inbox without asking you to submit everything again.
All right. One more thing: has the deadline been extended because of the website problem, or is it still five o'clock?
It is still five today. The alternative submission method is already available, and your tutor will explain the marking schedule in tomorrow's class.

questions.prompt: What problem is the group experiencing?
options: The online submission page is not working.
Their report has been deleted from both computers.
They cannot find the classroom for the presentation.
Their tutor has refused to accept interview notes.
questions.answer: The online submission page is not working.
questions.explanation: 小组在两台电脑上都遇到提交页面报错，说明问题出在在线提交通道。

questions.prompt: How should the report and interview notes be submitted?
options: As one printed document delivered to the office.
As separate files with the group number in both names.
As attachments sent individually by every group member.
As photographs pasted into a single email message.
questions.answer: As separate files with the group number in both names.
questions.explanation: 工作人员要求保留两个文件，并在各自文件名前加组号以便匹配。

questions.prompt: What should the sender do if no automatic reply arrives?
options: Wait until the next week's class.
Delete the original email and start a new report.
Wait fifteen minutes and then call the office.
Ask all other group members to send the same files.
questions.answer: Wait fifteen minutes and then call the office.
questions.explanation: 应等十五分钟后致电办公室，告知发送时间，由工作人员检查收件箱。

questions.prompt: What happens to the submission deadline?
options: It moves to the start of tomorrow's class.
It is extended by one week.
It depends on when each group receives a reply.
It remains at five o'clock that afternoon.
questions.answer: It remains at five o'clock that afternoon.
questions.explanation: 临时邮件通道已可使用，因此截止时间仍是当天下午五点。
